I don't know - my feeling is it's not ideal but it's probably fine.  If you look at the 1x1 and 0p5x1 you can see the ground through holes are generally close to both a mezzanine ground pin and a ground pad, providing a bunch of really good connections.
The 1x0p5 is a lot worse though - I'll definitely be improving that one.

The flip side of course is that putting holes in this region is also not ideal but probably fine - so I'll leave it to you and the others on this thread!
